analysis.narrativeEn:

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-25.8875→3.1264): Showing improvement from negative territory, suggesting potential bottoming.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($1,829.51): First resistance level on short-term rallies.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: No clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, indicating a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.61): Subdued volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Sideways consolidation within an accumulation phase, searching for direction. RSI exiting oversold and MACD showing improvement, but lack of volume warrants a wait-and-see approach.
